$comment: The interpolation findings both analyses give the five files of the test project in this folder, copied verbatim from the user's interpolationtests project, where every form also writes query, text from the request, somewhere it does harm: analyzeKotlin in editors/vscode/src/analyze.ts and Analyzer.analyzeKotlin in streamlord-analysis, each file on its own, with the const vals the workspace declares (constants) known, as the VS Code index and IntelliJ provide them. Only the interpolation codes are listed (kotlin-interpolation, unescaped-interpolation, unsafe-interpolation), and missing-id and top-level-text must not appear in any file. Offsets count UTF-16 code units; line is for the reader. What IntelliJ adds with types is in the plugin's own InspectionTest.
